review_comments.body: **Stylesheet links escape test cleanup** The new relative stylesheet links no longer match the `afterEach` selector, which still uses `link[href^="/api/notes/"]`. Both links now stay in `document.head` after this test, so later tests inherit them. Update the cleanup selector to match the new paths too.
